versions.content: The function EthSwt_GetBaudRate shall read the current baud rate of the indexed switch port. If the indexed Ethernet port reference an Ethernet transceiver, the baud rate shall be obtained by the function EthTrcv_GetBaudRate of the Ethernet Transceiver Driver. If the indexed Ethernet Switch port does not reference an Ethernet transceiver, the baud rate shall be obtained from the MAC interface of the Switch port.
